subject: Kickoff: MAP + Evaluation pathway for Blue Ridge Analytics - next 8 weeks
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueridge.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: MAP + Evaluation pathway for Blue Ridge Analytics - next 8 weeks

Alex — great to connect yesterday. Thanks for the time. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off the mutual action plan (MAP) and share the engineering handoff plan so we can get the evaluation running in the next 7–8 weeks.

Quick summary / goals:
- Objective: Prove parity on key production metrics (latency P95 <= 120ms, end-to-end throughput target ~60 rps for peak traffic pattern) and validate cost per 1k tokens under expected batch sizes.
- Scope: hosted Redwood evaluation using your representative model weights and a small on-prem test for security validation (if needed).
- Timeline: Week 0 (this week) — kickoff and access; Weeks 1–3 — baseline benchmarking & integration; Weeks 4–6 — optimization (batching/quant); Week 7 — evaluation report + decision meeting.

Introducing our technical leads: Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer) will run the integration and test harness; Rishi Malhotra (ML Engineer) will lead performance tuning and regression checks. They’re looped above.

Next steps I propose:
1) 60-minute kickoff (tech + security + product) — proposed slots: Thu 1/8 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 1/9 14:00–15:00 PT. Please confirm a slot and attendee list.
2) Alex — share a short sample payload set and the S3 staging bucket + access pattern we should use.
3) We’ll upload a filled MAP template (attached) with milestones and owner names by end of day.

Attachments: BR_MAP_Template_v1.xlsx (MAP template)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Cheers,
Logan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0191

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueridge.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@blueridge.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jan 2026 12:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + Evaluation pathway for Blue Ridge Analytics - next 8 weeks

Logan — thanks for the thorough outline. Thu 1/8 10:00 PT works for our team. I’ll join along with Priya (PO), and I’ll add Tom Baker (our security lead) if that’s ok.

Couple of asks up front so Dev/Rishi can prepare: 
- Payloads: we’ll provide a 2k-sample set covering short/long prompts and a spike traffic trace for peak hours (S3 link to follow).
- Data access: we prefer temporary IAM role with scoped read for the staging bucket. Please send your required IAM trust policy and a short list of IPs that need outbound egress whitelisting.
- Success criteria: we agree with latency/throughput buckets but would like you to capture token-level cost estimates per config in the MAP.

We’ll be joined on Thu by: me (alex.chen@blueridge.com), Priya Shah (priya.shah@blueridge.com), Tom Baker (tbaker@blueridge.com), and Daniel Hsu (daniel.hsu@blueridge.com, infra lead).

I’ll circulate the sample payload and an initial meeting invite shortly.

—Alex
Engineering Lead, Blue Ridge Analytics
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueridge.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 09:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + Evaluation pathway for Blue Ridge Analytics - next 8 weeks

Alex / Team — thanks, roster looks good. I’ll own the kickoff agenda and run the integration checklist. Attaching a short infra checklist that covers endpoints, auth, and expected sample size.

Initial technical agenda (30–40 min of the 60):
- Integration plan: where to mount the S3 payloads, expected file layout, and auth method (IAM role vs presigned).
- Test harness: describe the load generator we’ll use (locally reproducible runner + config), and what telemetry we’ll collect (latency P50/P95/P99, token counts, error rates).
- Benchmark seeds: we’ll run three baseline configs — (A) default FP16, (B) 4-bit quantized, (C) cached prefix path for chat flows.
- Security notes: we’ll need a short allowlist for our egress; Tom, if you can confirm desired CIDR blocks we’ll validate.

Please see attached: infra-checklist.md (short checklist / ask list).

On the IAM trust: we recommend temporary cross-account role with session duration <= 1 hour and S3:GetObject on the payload bucket. If you prefer presigned URLs, we can work with that too.

Looking forward to the call — I’ll share the runner repo and a sample load config during the meeting.

Best,
Dev
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueridge.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + Evaluation pathway for Blue Ridge Analytics - next 8 weeks

Alex / Priya — quick note from the ML side: for the evaluation we’ll measure (and report) the following per-run metrics:
- Latency: P50 / P95 / P99 (inference-only and end-to-end)
- Throughput: tokens-per-second and requests-per-second at target concurrency
- Cost: per-1k-token cost across the three baseline configs (A/B/C Dev mentioned)
- Quality/regression: a small automated eval set (100 prompts) and a manual spot-check for hallucination/formatting.

I’ll prepare an experiment config that includes seed, sequence lengths, and batch-size sweep. If you have custom prompts that require special tokenization (non-UTF8 characters or long code snippets), flag them now.

Also, quick ask for the kickoff: can your infra lead share the expected peak concurrency and an S3 path for the sample set before the call? That will let us pre-generate the runner configs.

Thanks — Rishi
ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@blueridge.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 14:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + Evaluation pathway for Blue Ridge Analytics - next 8 weeks

All — confirmed for Thu 1/8 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Attendees updated to include Daniel Hsu and Tom Baker.

Daniel provided the peak concurrency figure: 120 concurrent connections (burst to 200 for <2 minutes). S3 sample set will be at s3://br-eval/payloads/v1/ — I’ve granted a temporary read role to redwood-eval-role@example-trust (policy TTL = 1 hour).

Security ask: Tom requested your SOC 2 type II report and a short description of data retention and audit-log access for the evaluation environment. Can you drop a link to those in the shared Drive folder?

Final note: we’d like the MAP to include an explicit go/no-go gating criteria for the procurement team — I’ll work with Priya to add procurement acceptance items to the MAP template.

Thanks and see you on the call,
Alex
Engineering Lead, Blue Ridge Analytics
